result.summary: Found 4 layout issues: truncated carousel restaurant name, misaligned titles and delivery times in 'Fastest near you', inconsistent time-badge positioning, and bottom popular card clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off at the screen edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal list padding and truncate with ellipsis so full name is accessible on scroll

issues.description: 'Smash Bros Burgers' wraps to two lines pushing '2.40 delivery' lower than neighboring cards, causing vertical misalignment of titles and delivery fees.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card width, fixed title line-height with 1-line truncation or equal-height layout so metadata stays aligned

issues.description: Time badge on middle card '20-30 min' sits lower touching the bottom edge of the image while other badges are inset with padding.
issues.suggestion: Fix badge constraints to a consistent top or bottom inset for all carousel cards

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' pizza image with '-20%' is clipped behind the bottom tab bar with no name, rating or metadata visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so scrollable content sits above the Home/Search/Orders/Profile bar
